request.summary: Correct the ontology experiment so the architecture enforcement package can understand and evaluate architecture properties.
request.intent: Model concept types, typed properties, relations, profiles, language projections, observed facts, and deterministic constraint evaluation.

outputs: Portable, TypeScript, Python, and Rust profiles
Observed TypeScript fact graph and expected evaluation
validation: 12 concept types and 17 property definitions validated
4 relation definitions and 3 language projections validated
4 composed profiles and 42 profile-qualified constraints validated
JSON, Markdown links, and scoped whitespace validated
execution.notes: The first bridge-centered model was replaced. The corrected system ontology evaluates declared architecture properties over supplied observed facts; native source adapters remain future work.

workflow_gaps.evidence: User correction caused the candidate experiment to be replaced and revalidated.
